chapter: Reel 2: race, storm and Bolden vs Robichaux
title: Robichaux and Dejan: the band battle on the levee
summary: Mrs. Clementin tells of Dejan and Robichaux playing on opposite sides of the park while crowds went back and forth; Robichaux read sheet music and his drummer clowned.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel
